cheese-dip.description: Felix-style chile con queso as served by the El Patio Mexican Restaurant at 2416 Brazos in the Midtown district of Houston, Texas, USA.        Felix Mexican Restaurants were a Tex-Mex institution named after their founder, Felix Tijerina.  The first restaurant opened in 1937, expanding to six restaurants at its peak.  After the closure of the final restaurant in 2008, Scott Sullivan, an owner of the El Patio Mexican Restaurant chain, reached an agreement with Felix Tijerina Jr. to license Felix's name and recipes, which led to Felix's chile con queso becoming a permanent addition to El Patio's menu.        Felix's Queso Makes a Comeback        Felix Mexican Restaurant Closes After 60 Years in Business        Felix Mexican Restaurant.

red-dip.title: File:Chili sauce.jpg
red-dip.artist: samchills from frankfurt am main, Germany
red-dip.description:
die dunkle schokolade zerbrechen und mit ein wenig braunem zucker dazugeben. immer wieder umrühren, damit nichts anbrennt. ahornsirup und einen schuss whisky dazugeben. alles auf mittlerer stufe köcheln lassen bis die soße ein wenig dicker geworden ist. keine panik, wenn es aus dem topf raucht, das muss so ;)

This sauce was used in the preparation of vegan chili stew: add dark chocolate and some brown sugar. keep stiring, don't let it burn. add maple syrup and a shot of whiskey. let it simmer for quite a while. the sauce should get thicker. don't panic if it gets really smoky, it needs to be that way ;)

Crispy and golden vegetable spring rolls, filled with a vibrant mix of fresh vegetables such as carrots, cabbage, and bell peppers. Wrapped in thin pastry sheets and deep-fried to perfection, these rolls are a popular appetizer or snack in Asian cuisine. They are often served with tangy dipping sauces like sweet chili or soy sauce, adding a burst of flavor to every bite.
Ingredients: Thin pastry sheets, carrots, cabbage, bell peppers, sprouts, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and seasonings.
